original_test_intent: Run 250 NVIDIA WAT DC reboot cycles and use the HMC/BMC i2cPoll scenario to prove every approved management-bus device returns and remains error-free each cycle.
original_method: Validate WAT package/version/checksum/dependencies and exact scenario semantics; map BMC/HMC controllers, buses, addresses and expected device identities; define DC state/dwell/readiness/timeout; preserve baseline; with user confirmation run exact 250-cycle command using secure endpoints, record per-cycle power/OS/BMC/I2C inventory/events, abort without retry on failure, then recover and compare final inventory.
manual_activity: Operator provides WAT package/secrets, reserves dedicated SUT/power controller and supervises 250 cycles/recovery.
required_inputs: HMC/BMC controller/bus/address/device map and expected responses
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT and rated DC controller
Abort on missing I2C device, boot loop, BMC/OS timeout, power/electrical/thermal fault
agent_execution_scope: May validate package/config and analyze cycle artifacts
Must not assume WAT package/secrets or launch 250 cycles without explicit execution confirmation

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Source command is applicable only after WAT scenario semantics and HMC/BMC I2C mapping are confirmed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact approved wat_runner command with secure BMC endpoint, 250 cycles, per-cycle I2C oracle and fail-fast policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DC reboot, i2cPoll via HMC/BMC, exact scenarios and 250 cycles retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create per-cycle ledger of DC transition/readiness and complete controller-bus-address inventory diffs.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds package/scenario provenance, management-bus identity, secure secrets, timeouts and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Host Linux I2C listing or final inventory cannot replace HMC/BMC per-cycle polling.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wistron rule treats I2C as platform-management scope; wrong bus/address or lost OOB can invalidate all cycles.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines authoritative WAT scenario semantics, expected I2C device set and retry/termination policy.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row81 Wistron-Long Term Stress-00012-V001: approve NVIDIA WAT version/checksum/dependencies and scenario semantics, BMC/HMC controller-bus-address/expected I2C device map, secure endpoint/credential path, DC off/on state/dwell and readiness timeouts, 250-cycle per-device/event oracle, fail-fast/no-retry, OOB and recovery.

review_improvement: Makes i2cPoll prove exact management-bus devices on every DC cycle and safeguards the destructive harness.
independent_technical_reasoning: A final healthy boot can hide intermittent management-bus loss. I2C identity must be tied to BMC/HMC controller, bus and address, and compared per cycle; host enumeration alone does not prove the intended path.
